company.summary: D. COFFEE AS is a private limited company (aksjeselskap) registered under drift av restauranter (NACE 56.110), based in Oslo, founded 2012-07-09. Registered activity: Drift av serveringssteder, handel med næringsmidler, leie, eie og drift av fast eiendom, samt tjenesteyting og investeringer relatert til nevnte og lignende aktiviteter, samt alt som står i forbindelse med dette. Latest filed accounts (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, company accounts): revenue NOK 179.7 m, operating result NOK -5.8 m, net result NOK -5.5 m, total assets NOK 61.9 m, equity NOK 4.0 m. The period closed with a loss. Change from 2024 to 2025: revenue went from NOK 169.4 m to NOK 179.7 m (+6%); net result went from NOK -9.3 m to NOK -5.5 m; equity went from NOK 5.6 m to NOK 4.0 m (-28%). Financial position in 2025: operating margin -3.2%; equity ratio 6.5%. Calculated from the filed figures above. Registered employees: 231. Leadership in the official register: Per Jonas Bergström (managing director); Jon Thomas Warset (chair of the board); KPMG AS (auditor). 22 registered workplaces in Bergen, Bodø, Drammen, Jessheim, Kristiansand S, Kråkerøy and more. Appears to be hiring: 3 active job ads with an exact employer match (Barista og Skiftleder til Starbucks Bodø; Barista og Skiftleder til Starbucks; Assistant Store Manager Starbucks Kristiansand). Latest official food safety inspection (2026-09-29), Starbucks Oslo City: minor violations not requiring follow-up (smiling face). Most recent registry event: Registered employee count updated (2026-11-12). Not established from checked sources: verified website (not available); website description (not available); company-owned social profiles (not available). Missing information is not treated as zero.
